alt_variants.conditions: as main variant; boron partner read as the free boronic acid

notes: (1) The Suzuki partner is called only 'phenylborate ester' (3j) / 'corresponding borate ester' (3k); the aryl group (3-hydroxymethyl-4-methoxyphenyl) is certain from the product, but the boron group is NOT stated. I wrote the pinacol ester as the main reading (the usual commercial reagent) and the free boronic acid as the alternative; the name field is empty because the paper gives none. (2) 'Compound 14' has no printed name; its structure (2-amino-6-chloronicotinamide) is derived from the name of its product 15 and checked by mass (500 mg = 2.90 mmol gives MW about 172). The paper states all chemicals were obtained by commercial purchase, so 14 is a leaf. (3) The 3j experimental paragraph repeats a stray sentence about 3S-methylmorpholine after the Suzuki step (copy-paste artefact), ignored. (4) Step 3 combines POCl3 chlorination and morpholine displacement as one procedure; counted as one step. (5) Stereocentre: (S)-3-methylmorpholine written as C[C@H]1COCCN1 and, in the N-aryl products, N2CCOC[C@@H]2C (same (S) centre; please let the checker confirm the CIP label). (6) Scheme 2 lists letters h/i/j twice; the 3j steps are the ones in 4.1.18-4.1.21.
